    "FUNCTION TR_TADIR_INTERFACE.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_DELETE_TADIR_ENTRY) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"         DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_REMOVE_REPAIR_FLAG) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED",
    "*\"         DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_SET_REPAIR_FLAG) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TEST_MODUS) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_PGMID) LIKE  TADIR-PGMID",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_OBJECT) LIKE  TADIR-OBJECT",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_OBJ_NAME) LIKE  TADIR-OBJ_NAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_KORRNUM) LIKE  TADIR-KORRNUM DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_SRCSYSTEM) LIKE  TADIR-SRCSYSTEM DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_AUTHOR) LIKE  TADIR-AUTHOR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_DEVCLASS) LIKE  TADIR-DEVCLASS DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_MASTERLANG) LIKE  TADIR-MASTERLANG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_CPROJECT) LIKE  TADIR-CPROJECT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_VERSID) LIKE  TADIR-VERSID DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_REMOVE_GENFLAG) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_SET_GENFLAG) LIKE  TADIR-GENFLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_READ_ONLY) LIKE  TRPARI-S_CHECKED DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_EDTFLAG) LIKE  TADIR-EDTFLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TRANSL_TECH_TEXT) TYPE  TADIR-TRANSLTTXT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_DELFLAG) TYPE  TADIR-DELFLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_NO_PAK_CHECK) TYPE  TADIR-PAKNOCHECK DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_OBJ_STABILITY) TYPE  TADIR-OBJSTABLTY DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_CHECK_DATE) TYPE  TADIR-CHECK_DATE DEFAULT ''",
    "*\"     VALUE(WI_TADIR_CHECK_CFG) TYPE  TADIR-CHECK_CFG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(NEW_GTADIR_ENTRY) LIKE  GTADIR STRUCTURE  GTADIR",
    "*\"     VALUE(NEW_TADIR_ENTRY) LIKE  TADIR STRUCTURE  TADIR",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      TADIR_ENTRY_NOT_EXISTING",
    "*\"      TADIR_ENTRY_ILL_TYPE",
    "*\"      NO_SYSTEMNAME",
    "*\"      NO_SYSTEMTYPE",
    "*\"      ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_CONFLICT",
    "*\"      OBJECT_RESERVED_FOR_DEVCLASS",
    "*\"      OBJECT_EXISTS_GLOBAL",
    "*\"      OBJECT_EXISTS_LOCAL",
    "*\"      OBJECT_IS_DISTRIBUTED",
    "*\"      OBJ_SPECIFICATION_NOT_UNIQUE",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORIZATION_TO_DELETE",
    "*\"      DEVCLASS_NOT_EXISTING",
    "*\"      SIMULTANIOUS_SET_REMOVE_REPAIR",
    "*\"      ORDER_MISSING",
    "*\"      NO_MODIFICATION_OF_HEAD_SYST",
    "*\"      PGMID_OBJECT_NOT_ALLOWED",
    "*\"      MASTERLANGUAGE_NOT_SPECIFIED",
    "*\"      DEVCLASS_NOT_SPECIFIED",
    "*\"      SPECIFY_OWNER_UNIQUE",
    "*\"      LOC_PRIV_OBJS_NO_REPAIR",
    "*\"      GTADIR_NOT_REACHED",
    "*\"      OBJECT_LOCKED_FOR_ORDER",
    "*\"      CHANGE_OF_CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED",
    "*\"      NO_CHANGE_FROM_SAP_TO_TMP",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "DATA: LV_WBO_INTERNAL          LIKE TRPARI-FLAG VALUE SPACE,",
    "      LV_FORCE_MODE            LIKE TRPARI-FLAG VALUE SPACE ,",
    "      iv_transl_tech_text_supp(1)  TYPE c VALUE ' ' ,",
    "      iv_delflag_supp(1) TYPE c VALUE   ' ' ,",
    "      IV_NO_PAK_CHECK_supp(1)  TYPE c VALUE ' ' ,",
    "      IV_OBJ_STABILITY_supp(1)  TYPE c VALUE ' '   .",
    "",
    "",
    "*& check if there is input for some import parameter",
    "  IF iv_transl_tech_text  IS SUPPLIED  .",
    "    iv_transl_tech_text_supp = 'X' .",
    "  ENDIF .",
    "",
    "  IF  iv_delflag IS SUPPLIED  .",
    "    iv_delflag_supp = 'X' .",
    "  ENDIF .",
    "",
    " IF IV_NO_PAK_CHECK  IS SUPPLIED  .",
    "    IV_NO_PAK_CHECK_supp = 'X' .",
    "  ENDIF .",
    "",
    " IF  IV_OBJ_STABILITY IS SUPPLIED  .",
    "    IV_OBJ_STABILITY_supp = 'X' .",
    "  ENDIF .",
    "",
    "CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_TADIR_INTERFACE'",
    "     EXPORTING",
    "          WI_DELETE_TADIR_ENTRY          = WI_DELETE_TADIR_ENTRY",
    "          WI_REMOVE_REPAIR_FLAG          = WI_REMOVE_REPAIR_FLAG",
    "          WI_SET_REPAIR_FLAG             = WI_SET_REPAIR_FLAG",
    "          WI_TEST_MODUS                  = WI_TEST_MODUS",
    "          WI_TADIR_PGMID                 = WI_TADIR_PGMID",
    "          WI_TADIR_OBJECT                = WI_TADIR_OBJECT",
    "          WI_TADIR_OBJ_NAME              = WI_TADIR_OBJ_NAME",
    "          WI_TADIR_KORRNUM               = WI_TADIR_KORRNUM",
    "          WI_TADIR_SRCSYSTEM             = WI_TADIR_SRCSYSTEM",
    "          WI_TADIR_AUTHOR                = WI_TADIR_AUTHOR",
    "          WI_TADIR_DEVCLASS              = WI_TADIR_DEVCLASS",
    "          WI_TADIR_MASTERLANG            = WI_TADIR_MASTERLANG",
    "          WI_TADIR_CPROJECT              = WI_TADIR_CPROJECT",
    "          WI_TADIR_VERSID                = WI_TADIR_VERSID",
    "          WI_REMOVE_GENFLAG              = WI_REMOVE_GENFLAG",
    "          WI_SET_GENFLAG                 = WI_SET_GENFLAG",
    "          WI_READ_ONLY                   = WI_READ_ONLY",
    "          IV_SET_EDTFLAG                 = IV_SET_EDTFLAG",
    "          IV_WBO_INTERNAL                = LV_WBO_INTERNAL",
    "          IV_INSERT_MODE                 = LV_FORCE_MODE",
    "          IV_TRANSL_TECH_TEXT            = IV_TRANSL_TECH_TEXT",
    "          IV_DELFLAG                     = IV_DELFLAG",
    "          IV_NO_PAK_CHECK                = IV_NO_PAK_CHECK",
    "          IV_OBJ_STABILITY               = IV_OBJ_STABILITY",
    "          iv_transl_tech_text_supp       = iv_transl_tech_text_supp",
    "          iv_delflag_supp                = iv_delflag_supp",
    "          IV_NO_PAK_CHECK_supp =  IV_NO_PAK_CHECK_supp",
    "          IV_OBJ_STABILITY_supp  =  IV_OBJ_STABILITY_supp",
    "          WI_TADIR_CHECK_DATE            = WI_TADIR_CHECK_DATE",
    "          WI_TADIR_CHECK_CFG             = WI_TADIR_CHECK_CFG",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "          NEW_GTADIR_ENTRY               = NEW_GTADIR_ENTRY",
    "          NEW_TADIR_ENTRY                = NEW_TADIR_ENTRY",
    "     EXCEPTIONS",
    "          TADIR_ENTRY_NOT_EXISTING       = 1",
    "          TADIR_ENTRY_ILL_TYPE           = 2",
    "          NO_SYSTEMNAME                  = 3",
    "          NO_SYSTEMTYPE                  = 4",
    "          ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_CONFLICT       = 5",
    "          OBJECT_RESERVED_FOR_DEVCLASS   = 6",
    "          OBJECT_EXISTS_GLOBAL           = 7",
    "          OBJECT_EXISTS_LOCAL            = 8",
    "          OBJECT_IS_DISTRIBUTED          = 9",
    "          OBJ_SPECIFICATION_NOT_UNIQUE   = 10",
    "          NO_AUTHORIZATION_TO_DELETE     = 11",
    "          DEVCLASS_NOT_EXISTING          = 12",
    "          SIMULTANIOUS_SET_REMOVE_REPAIR = 13",
    "          ORDER_MISSING                  = 14",
    "          NO_MODIFICATION_OF_HEAD_SYST   = 15",
    "          PGMID_OBJECT_NOT_ALLOWED       = 16",
    "          MASTERLANGUAGE_NOT_SPECIFIED   = 17",
    "          DEVCLASS_NOT_SPECIFIED         = 18",
    "          SPECIFY_OWNER_UNIQUE           = 19",
    "          LOC_PRIV_OBJS_NO_REPAIR        = 20",
    "          GTADIR_NOT_REACHED             = 21",
    "          OBJECT_LOCKED_FOR_ORDER        = 22",
    "          CHANGE_OF_CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED    = 23",
    "          NO_CHANGE_FROM_SAP_TO_TMP      = 24.",
    "   CASE SY-SUBRC.",
    "      WHEN  1. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  TADIR_ENTRY_NOT_EXISTING.",
    "      WHEN  2. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  TADIR_ENTRY_ILL_TYPE.",
    "      WHEN  3. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  NO_SYSTEMNAME.",
    "      WHEN  4. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  NO_SYSTEMTYPE.",
    "      WHEN  5. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_CONFLICT.",
    "      WHEN  6. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  OBJECT_RESERVED_FOR_DEVCLASS.",
    "      WHEN  7. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  OBJECT_EXISTS_GLOBAL.",
    "      WHEN  8. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  OBJECT_EXISTS_LOCAL.",
    "      WHEN  9. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  OBJECT_IS_DISTRIBUTED.",
    "       when 10. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING OBJ_SPECIFICATION_NOT_UNIQUE.",
    "      WHEN 11. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  NO_AUTHORIZATION_TO_DELETE.",
    "      WHEN 12. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  DEVCLASS_NOT_EXISTING.",
    "      WHEN 13. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  SIMULTANIOUS_SET_REMOVE_REPAIR.",
    "      WHEN 14. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  ORDER_MISSING.",
    "      WHEN 15. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  NO_MODIFICATION_OF_HEAD_SYST.",
    "      WHEN 16. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  PGMID_OBJECT_NOT_ALLOWED.",
    "      WHEN 17. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  MASTERLANGUAGE_NOT_SPECIFIED.",
    "      WHEN 18. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  DEVCLASS_NOT_SPECIFIED.",
    "      WHEN 19. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  SPECIFY_OWNER_UNIQUE.",
    "      WHEN 20. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  LOC_PRIV_OBJS_NO_REPAIR.",
    "      WHEN 21. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  GTADIR_NOT_REACHED.",
    "      WHEN 22. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  OBJECT_LOCKED_FOR_ORDER.",
    "      WHEN 23. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  CHANGE_OF_CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED.",
    "      WHEN 24. CURRENT_MESSAGE_RAISING  NO_CHANGE_FROM_SAP_TO_TMP.",
    "   ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
